## Architecture Exploration Findings

The project is a Minecraft-like Among Us modding suite with two main assemblies: **LightAPI** (framework/library) and **Light** (mod content/patches). Note: LightAPI's `LightInDark.csproj` namespace is `LightInDark.*`; Light's is `Light.*`.

### 1. LightAPI (framework, namespace `LightInDark.*`)
- **Game/** (`Player.cs`, `GameManager.cs`, `IGame.cs`, `GameEntityExtension.cs`):
  - `Player` (LightAPI/Game/Player.cs) implements `IPlayer`, `IBindPlayer`, `IGameOperator`, `ILifespan`. Wraps `PlayerControl`, exposes `Control`, `IsDead`, `IsLocal`, `Name`, `Position`, `Role` (a `RuntimeRole`). `SetRole()/SetRoleLocal()` handle role switching (local + RPC sync). Uses a `PlayerState` enum with comment "复盘/Review" fields (`Dead`, `Suicide`, `BeGuessed`, `BeKilled`, `GoOff`, `Exile`) — the only hint of reviewing/replay anywhere.
  - `GameManager` (singleton `Instance`) registers `Player` entities in `Initialize()` (called from RoleSelectPatch), exposes `LocalPlayer`, `GetPlayer(byte playerId)`, `AllPlayers`.
- **RPCs/**: `RpcDefinitions.cs` (custom `[LidRPC]` methods + `GameActions` static helper class), `CustomRPC.cs`, `LidRPC.cs`. Has `SetRole`, `Suicide`, `MurderPlayer`, `RevivePlayer`, `TeleportPlayer`, `StartMeeting`, `ForceEndMeeting`, `ShowChat/HideChat`, etc. NO game-end / result RPC exists yet.
- **Events/**: `Events.cs` (event class definitions) + `EventSystem.cs` (dispatcher). Events of interest: `GameStartEvent`, `GameEndEvent { CrewmatesWin, ImpostorsWin, WinReason }`, `GameTryEndEvent` (cancelable), `PlayerDeathEvent { Player, Reoder, Reason }`, `PlayerMurderEvent`, `PlayerVoteEvent`, `MeetingEndEvent`, `PlayerExileEvent`, `RoleAssignedEvent`, `ChatMessageEvent`. `GameEndEvent` already exists as a data class but NO code fires it yet.
- **Roles/**: `DefinedRole.cs` (static def: Name, Color, Category, Description, Id, Allocation, DefaultArguments, CreateInstance), `RuntimeRole.cs`, `RoleRegistry.cs` (register + lookup by name/type/id; has `Clear()` "called at game end" but is not currently wired), `RoleAllocator.cs`/`AllocationParameters.cs`/`PlayerTracker.cs`/`RoleDocument.cs`.
- **UI/Window/** — generic window system.

### 2. Light (mod, namespace `Light.*`)
- **Patches/**: `GameEndPatch.cs` exists but is an **empty stub** — `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(AmongUsClient), nameof(AmongUsClient.OnGameEnd))]` with an empty class body (no methods). This is the intended hook point for game-end logic.
- **Patches/RoleInterceptPatch.cs** — the main interception file. Patches `GameManager.StartGame` (disables `ShouldCheckForGameEnd`, fires `GameStartEvent`), blocks `CheckTaskCompletion`, `CheckEndGameViaTasks` (fires `GameTryEndEvent`), `IsGameOverDueToDeath`, blocks RoleManager/SelectRoles (custom allocation), `PlayerControl.Die` (fires `PlayerDeathEvent`), `ReportDeadBody`, `MeetingHud.Confirm` (vote), `AmongUsClient.OnPlayerLeft`, `ExileController.Begin`, `ShipStatus.BreakEmergencyButton`.

- **ChatCommands/**: `PatchManager.cs` (Harmony class; `IsHost`, `SendLocalMessage`, `SendNormalMessage`, `OnSendChat` command dispatcher — `/test`, `/suicide`, `/showchat`, etc. — 143 lines total).
- **UI/**: `Ability/`, `Help/`, `HudUI/`, `Window/`, `ImageGalleryPanel.cs`.

### 3. Game-end / replay systems status
- **GameEndPatch.cs** is an empty stub ready for implementation.
- **`GameEndEvent`** exists in Events.cs but is **never fired** anywhere (no producer found).
- **No replay/review/post-game system exists.** The only "复盘" references are comments in `LightAPI/Game/Player.cs` (`PlayerState` doc comments about recording killer). `RoleRegistry.Clear()` is documented "called at game end" but not wired up.

- Hook: flesh out `Light/Patches/GameEndPatch.cs` postfix on `AmongUsClient.OnGameEnd`.
- Run `EventSystem.RunEvent(new GameEndEvent {...})` and typically call `RoleRegistry.Clear()` and `GameManager.Instance.Release()`.
- Player data for a post-game report is available via `GameManager.Instance.AllPlayers` (each `Player` has `Name`, `Role`, `Control`, `IsDead`), and per-player kill/murder attribution exists via `PlayerMurderEvent`/`PlayerDeathEvent` but is NOT currently persisted anywhere.
- RPC plumbing (`[LidRPC]` + `GameActions`) is the pattern to follow if sending game results to clients.

- `Light/Patches/GameEndPatch.cs` (empty stub)
- `LightAPI/Events/Events.cs` (GameEndEvent definition, unfired)
- `LightAPI/Game/Player.cs` & `GameManager.cs` (player structure)

- `Light/Roles/Assignment/RoleTable.cs` & `StandardRoleAllocator.cs`
- `LightAPI/RPCs/RpcDefinitions.cs` (RPC pattern) & `LightAPI/Roles/RoleRegistry.cs`

# Instructions for MCP Server 'TJGenerators'
You are an AI generation assistant with 3D model, image, video, and world generation capabilities.

## Uploading Local Files (3-step workflow)

When a user provides a local file path (e.g. /path/to/image.png) and wants to use it as input for any generate_* tool:

1. Call `file_upload` with `file_path` → returns `{ upload_url, file_url, expires_in }`
2. Upload the actual file bytes by running a shell command: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT -T <file_path> "<upload_url>"`. Confirm output is `200`.
3. Use the returned `file_url` (NOT upload_url) as the `image_url` or `image_urls` parameter in generate_image / generate_3d_model / generate_video / generate_skybox / generate_world / generate_sprite_animation / generate_game_ui_kit / generate_sprite_atlas / upscale_image, as the `model_url` parameter in unirig_rig, or as the `audio_url` parameter in voice_clone.

## Generation Tools

- generate_3d_model: text-to-3D or image-to-3D (tripo P1 default, tripo H3.1 for ultra-high detail when explicitly requested, rodin Gen-2.5 for high-quality tiers, hunyuan 3.1 for explicit request or different-model retry)
- generate_image: text-to-image or image-to-image (seedream for fast/simple, seedream_pro for high-quality Seedream, frontier-game-design for highest quality/complex; auto-selected unless seedream_pro is explicitly requested)
- generate_video: text-to-video or image-to-video (Seedance2)
- generate_effect_video: chained VFX workflow — generates image then video (Seedance2) in one task
- generate_world: text-to-world or image-to-world (World Labs Marble)
- generate_sound_effect / generate_music / generate_tts / generate_material: audio & texture generation
- voice_clone: clone a voice from an audio sample, returns custom_voice_id for use with generate_tts voice_id

## Sprite Animation

- generate_sprite_animation: generate a 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier-game-design, then cut and assemble into a 2D sequence-frame animation in Unity
- generate_game_ui_kit: two-step async chain — Step 1 generates a game UI screenshot; Step 2 uses it as reference to produce a UI cutout sheet on magenta background for element extraction
- generate_sprite_atlas: pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture (synchronous, returns result immediately, no polling)
- upscale_image: AI super-resolution upscaling via Real-ESRGAN (1x-8x, async, poll every 10s)

## Rigging & Motion Tools

- unirig_rig: auto-rig a 3D model (.glb/.fbx/.obj) into rigged FBX with skeleton and skin weights (UniRig)
- generate_motion: generate character animation from text description (HY Motion)

All generate_* tools return a task_id immediately (async). Use check_task with the task_id to poll for completion.
3D generation: 30s-3min. Video: 1-5min. Image: faster. World: 1-5min. Rigging & Motion: 1-3min.
Poll check_task every 40s for 3D/video/world/rigging/motion tasks, every 10s for other tasks, until status is "completed" or "failed".
IMPORTANT: You MUST launch a background subagent (task tool with run_in_background=true) to poll check_task at the recommended interval. Do NOT poll check_task directly in the foreground.
